name: aocl-developer-kit
description: Build custom processing layers for AOCL. Test layer behavior in isolation with the Playground. Create sentiment filters, validators, or domain-specific processors. Share plugins through the Marketplace.
shortDescription: Layer Playground, custom plugins, and Marketplace access.
author: QUOX
marketingPoints: Test any layer in isolation before production
Create custom L4 and L6 processing layers

layerPlayground.name: Layer Playground
layerPlayground.description: Interactive sandbox for testing layer behavior in isolation. Input custom queries, context, and config. See results, timing, and emitted events.

customPlugins.name: Custom Layer Plugins
customPlugins.description: Create custom processing layers that run inside the AOCL pipeline. Build sentiment filters, validators, classifiers, or domain-specific processors.

pluginMarketplace.name: Plugin Marketplace
pluginMarketplace.description: Browse, install, and share community plugins. Ratings, reviews, and one-click installation.

layerSDK.name: Layer SDK
layerSDK.description: Full SDK with TypeScript definitions, utilities, and examples. Build plugins faster with our development tools.

pluginEditor.name: Plugin Editor
pluginEditor.description: In-browser code editor with syntax highlighting, validation, and live testing. Export plugins when ready.

testCases.name: Pre-built Test Cases
testCases.description: Test your layers with pre-built scenarios for each layer type. One-click load and pass/fail indicators.

sandboxExecution.name: Sandboxed Execution
sandboxExecution.description: All plugins run in a secure sandbox with resource limits. CPU, memory, and network restrictions keep your system safe.

pluginVersioning.name: Plugin Versioning
pluginVersioning.description: Track plugin versions and rollback if needed. Semantic versioning support.

testimonials.quote: Built a custom sentiment filter in an afternoon. The Playground made testing a breeze.
testimonials.author: ML Engineer

testimonials.quote: Our domain-specific validation layer catches issues the base system would miss.
testimonials.author: Platform Architect
